notes: Two routes («ح» after Ibn al-Mubarak) meet in the names «مجالد، أبي الوداك، أبي سعيد» written once after them, so the tail belongs to both.
«وقال مسدد قلنا يا رسول الله» gives Musaddad's fuller wording of the same report with the same chain; a wording variant, left out.
«إن شئتم» and the rest are the Prophet's words; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
